title: Band-9 Samples: Where do you usually watch TV programmes/shows? [Why/why not?]
passage_html:
This post contains ideas and band-9 sample answers (audio included) for the Cambridge IELTS 13 Academic Speaking Part 1 Question 1 Test 1 question:

“Where do you usually watch TV programmes/shows? [Why/why not?]”

Sample 1

In all honesty, I rarely have the time to sit down and watch TV shows at home. So, I utilize my commute time by catching up on episodes on my mobile phone. The portability of smartphones has made it feasible to consume media effortlessly, even when on the go.

Sample 2

I predominantly enjoy television series and documentaries via online streaming platforms, like Netflix or Amazon Prime. The rationale behind this is their convenience and flexibility. Unlike traditional broadcasting, I have the liberty to watch my favorite shows anytime, without being bound by a specific schedule.

Sample 3

I typically watch TV shows while I’m on the treadmill at the gym. It’s a useful trick to divert my mind from the physical exertion and makes the workout sessions more enjoyable. This way, I can stay entertained while ensuring I get my daily dose of physical activity.

Sample 4

I generally watch TV shows in the background while I’m working or doing chores around the house. The audiovisual element helps to break the monotony of tasks and keeps me entertained. This approach allows me to follow the storyline without needing to dedicate exclusive time to watching.

Sample 5

I tend to take in my favorite television series and documentaries from the comfort of my own living room, cozied up on my plush sofa. The predominant reason behind this preference is the feeling of relaxation that my home environment offers. There’s nothing quite like enjoying an intriguing crime thriller with a cup of hot cocoa in hand, free from the distractions of the outside world.

Sample 6

I often find myself watching shows late at night in my bedroom, a ritual that helps me unwind from the day’s stresses. The quiet and solitude provide a peaceful atmosphere, allowing me to immerse myself fully in the narrative. It’s like a mini-escape from reality before I drift off to sleep.

Sample 7

To be frank, I don’t devote much time to television shows. Leading an active lifestyle, I prefer to spend my leisure time on physical activities like hiking, swimming, or yoga. These activities not only keep me physically fit but also provide a sense of satisfaction that passive television watching seldom delivers.

Sample 8

Truth be told, I don’t often watch TV programmes. I’m an avid reader and find the world within books much more intriguing. Whether it’s a gripping mystery novel or a profound philosophical treatise, the depth and nuance that written words offer are, in my opinion, unmatched by visual media like television.

Sample 9

Actually, I seldom engage in viewing television broadcasts. The primary reason lies in my pursuit of knowledge. The unfiltered internet offers an immensely wider selection of informative content, such as scientific research, academic lectures, and insightful podcasts, which simply aren’t available on traditional TV. I find myself more intellectually stimulated and better informed through these alternatives.

Sample 10

Frankly speaking, I don’t spend much time watching traditional television. As a tech enthusiast, I find that the content on mainstream TV often doesn’t keep pace with the swiftly evolving technology landscape. Instead, I frequent online platforms and forums where I can stay updated on the latest tech trends and innovations.
